headline: Strong Singapore Dollar Reflects Fundamentals; PM Lawrence Wong: Singapore Will Not Pursue Low-Cost Competition - Liberty Times Finance
summary: Singapore Prime Minister Lawrence Wong said the strength and stability of the Singapore dollar reflect the economy's fundamentals. He said Singapore will not pursue low-cost competition.
why: The Singapore dollar is managed against a basket of trading partners' currencies by the central bank, so official comments on its strength matter for regional trade and capital flows.

impacts.name: Singapore dollar
impacts.why: Official remarks on the currency's strength reflect and may influence expectations for the Singapore dollar.
